facts.text: On the big screen tonight: Dottie's catch in the splits. Evelyn's team song.
facts.why: Stock stadium wording. A 1943 ballpark has no big screen; the line reads as a modern stadium. The two moments it lists are true (Dottie's splits catch for the Life photographer, Evelyn's team song).
facts.fix: Tonight at the park: Dottie's catch in the splits. Evelyn's team song.
facts.applied_text: Tonight at the park: Dottie's catch in the splits. Evelyn's team song.

notes: Jimmy's 'There's no crying in baseball!' to Evelyn, 'Betti Spaghetti' (Wikiquote spelling, Betty in the cast list), 'wave your little hat around, but don't drink', 75 dollars against 30 at the dairy, Harvey bars, and 'The hard... is what makes it great' all confirmed on Wikiquote. Seven-game series against Racine and Kit running through the stop sign confirmed on Wikipedia. Dish notes print on the phone only; the card shows names.

vibe.verdict: Cents prices, the Game 7 ticket and Jimmy's line make a good 1943 stand, but the scoreboard still reads Home 3 2 1 2 8 against Guests all zeros and the stand's food is plain ballpark fare.
